name: tmr_anchor_and_cap4_control_characterisation

checks.evidence: User supplied APPROVE STAGE 00 on 2026-08-11, authorizing Stage 01 execution.
TMR solve mode passed 13/13 checks. surface.fmt SHA-256 matched 6625b41253dd527207e796c10f08ade30676b055625c7e9baefd30131962b6d4; volume audit was clean with zero negative-quality layers.
ADflow force anchor matched the recorded values: CL 1.0917740093456412 and CD 0.013164679005086222.
Dry-run generated all 10 locked seed-7 current-design-space cap4 L3 surfaces successfully and wrote deterministic surface.fmt hashes in 03_cap4_epse/epse_calibration_report.json.

No epsE candidate survives on the cap4 control: at L3 on lhs7_00, epsE 1.5 gives 10 inverted cells, 2.0 gives 4, and 3.0 gives none but 53 low/negative-quality layers (min quality -0.90808). Root cause established: the cap4 airfoil-face tip cap corners on an OML block split, every split lands on a smooth part of the contour, and the resulting corner is ~180 deg by construction (179.737 deg at split_x_fore 0.10, 0.20 and 0.35 alike). Recorded as an S0 volume-gate failure per ADR-0006; epsE_common_start re-based to Stage 02 per ADR-0007.

L1 and L2 probes at epsE 1.5 both produced valid volumes with ZERO inverted cells (vs 10 at L3) but still failed the quality rule: L1 60 low/negative-quality layers, L2 55, L3 53. The near-constant count across levels and across epsE confirms the defect is not a resolution or marching-parameter problem.
04_strategy_prototypes/strategy_interface.py defines S0-S5 strategy ids, required artifact names, stable hashing, and common connectivity manifest helpers.

Stage 02 requires the user token APPROVE STAGE 01. Scope on approval: S1 and S3 first, since both anchor tip blocks on genuine geometric features rather than arbitrary x/c splits. S2 remains blocked on its cross-field/quad-extraction dependency per the Stage 00 dependency audit.

Three independent surface-only probes: (a) scale-invariant metrics identical to 11-12 significant figures across all 10 locked geometries, worst block tip_center_0 every time; (b) worst tip corner 179.737 deg and min_shape_metric 3.7160e-04 unchanged at split_x_fore 0.10 / 0.20 / 0.35, all verified applied; (c) cgrid_face tip matches airfoil_face to 11 significant figures with worse skew and scaled Jacobian. The corner is degenerate by construction and is not tunable.

lhs7_00 tip-station section: 61 points, ZERO collapsed segments below 1e-9, min segment 3.728e-03, median 3.852e-02, max turning angle 41.96 deg at the leading edge. No cusp. The OML handed to the mesher is clean, so S1-S5 do not inherit the defect and no upstream geometry repair is required before Stage 02.

All three legacy OML topologies fail at the tip; cap4 is least bad. mid4 rejected: positive_scaled_jacobian in tip_ring_2 (-6.898e-02), quad_triangle_normal_alignment -1.0. split8 rejected: tip_ring_5 (-2.838e-01), alignment -1.0, plus open_boundary_off_root_plane. Both were caught by the scaled-Jacobian gate added under ADR-0005; before that fix they would have been accepted silently and marched.

min_scaled_jacobian > 0.0 is now a hard pre-pyHyp failure (check id positive_scaled_jacobian, src/aeris/mesh/surface.py) and is enforced end to end: export raises MeshBuildError and writes no CGNS. The post-hoc min_shape_metric 0.03 and 170 deg thresholds were rescinded as unsupported. 182 tests pass across tests/mesh and tests/cfd.

warnings: The full 30-row L3 epsE sweep was never run; epse_calibration_report.json is dry-run evidence only. The marching findings rest on lhs7_00. This is sufficient because the surface defect was shown to be identical across all ten geometries to 11-12 significant figures.
The prepared L1 prevalence and L3 overnight campaigns are cancelled, not merely held: both would characterise a topology the tournament exists to replace.
Invalid L3 epsE 1.5 and 2.0 CGNS outputs were quarantined in their probe work directories.
The cap4 historical regression remains qualitative only, per Stage 00 ADR-0003.
No end-to-end regression test covers the real folded-surface path; the Variant B test injects the condition. tip_smooth_iters=20 does not fold the synthetic test geometry.

cap4_root_cause.mechanism: airfoil-face tip cap corners on an OML block split that lies on a smooth contour; edges are collinear

findings.detail: S0/cap4 is recorded as failing the volume gate and is NOT repaired. It stays in the tournament as a documented regression baseline per RUNBOOK Section 6.
epsE_common_start moves to Stage 02, calibrated on the first strategy passing all hard surface gates on all ten calibration geometries, in an implementation order fixed in advance.
